results.title: 9 Best Spokeo Alternatives in 2026 (Free & Paid, Ranked)
results.content:
### 2. BeenVerified, closest US public-records match

BeenVerified is the most direct Spokeo-style alternative: US public records, contact info, and background context on a subscription. Good if you specifically want the records-search experience. Same limits as Spokeo on live social and cross-platform correlation.

### 3. TruePeopleSearch, best free option

TruePeopleSearch offers free US name, phone, and address lookups with no signup. Coverage is US-only and record-based, but for a quick free check it beats paying. Pair it with free OSINT tools for social and breach data.

### 4. Social Catfish, best for reverse-image and dating checks [...] People Search July 9, 2026 9 min read By espectrosint Team

# 9 Best Spokeo Alternatives in 2026 (Free & Paid)

The best Spokeo alternatives in 2026 are espectrosint (best for cross-source OSINT across email, phone, and username), BeenVerified (closest US public-records match), TruePeopleSearch (best free option), Social Catfish (best for reverse-image and dating checks), and Pipl (best for professional identity resolution). Each fits a different need. The full ranked list below covers 9 tools with what they do, pricing, and a side-by-side table.

Key Takeaways [...] If your goal is verifying a suspicious contact, checking a possible catfish, or running due diligence, you usually want broader sources and cross-referencing, not just a records sheet. That is where the alternatives below pull ahead.

## The 9 Best Spokeo Alternatives in 2026

### 1. espectrosint, best for cross-source OSINT

espectrosint takes a single input (email, phone, username, or name) and queries 200+ open sources in parallel, then correlates the results into one profile: linked social accounts, breach history, likely name, and photos. Where Spokeo returns a records sheet, espectrosint returns a map of who is behind an address. It also runs an AI dossier and exports to PDF. Honest limit: it works with public and semi-public data, so a careful person can still stay hidden.
